payload.claim: This docstring states as a blanket fact that 'a run_one_cell raise ... read[s] as unmarked', but after this change a run_one_cell raise can be marked when ready_task admits the resulting task (exactly what the new test test_a_raising_cell_whose_orphaned_task_is_green_names_saffron_package in this same file demonstrates). The task's own notes flagged this exact sentence ('tests/test_task.py:2370-2373 says a run_one_cell raise reads as unmarked. Its case has no task, so say so.') as needing correction to explain that this particular case is unmarked only because no task exists for it, and that correction was not made, leaving the docstring's generalization false.
